latest.title: otosora v0.8.0
latest.notes:
# Otosora 0.8.0

## Phone and computer
- Sync favourites and playlists between the phone and the computer over the same Wi-Fi. On the computer open Settings → Sync with your phone, then enter its address and code on the phone in Settings → Sync with your computer. Sync only adds; it never deletes. Songs from files are matched by title, artist and length, so a song has to be on both devices to show up in the other's playlist.
- Fade between songs: Now playing → menu → Fade between songs, up to 12 seconds.
- Pressing play after a long pause now continues the song you were on. Before, a stream queue could jump back to the first song.
- The visualizer stays on in the lyrics view and runs behind the mini player.
- The phone visualizer follows the beat more closely, using the same bands as the desktop app.

## Desktop
- Otosora updates itself. Open Updates in the sidebar; it downloads the new version, replaces the old one and restarts.
- Tray icon with play/pause, next, previous and the mini player. Closing the window keeps Otosora playing in the tray; turn that off in Settings → Close to the tray.
- Mini player: a small window that stays on top. Open it from the player bar or the tray, and drag it anywhere.
- Discord shows what you are listening to, when the Discord app is open. Turn it off in Settings.
- Linux: the visualizer now works. It hears everything the computer plays, not only Otosora, and needs `parec` (pulseaudio-utils) or `pw-record` (pipewire-utils).
- Linux: the tray icon needs libayatana-appindicator (Fedora: `sudo dnf install libayatana-appindicator-gtk3`).

## Updating from 0.7.1 on desktop
- 0.7.1 can't update itself yet. Download this version once by hand; later versions install from the app.
